description: Organize document layers: merge layers with duplicate names, delete empty layers, and/or sort layers alphabetically (A at top). Operations run in that order. The last remaining layer is never deleted.

deleteEmptyLayers.description: Delete layers that contain no page items and no guides (default false)

mergeSimilarLayers.description: Merge layers whose names are equal ignoring case, surrounding spaces and a trailing " copy" / " copy N" (default false)

sortLayers.description: Sort layers alphabetically by name (default false)

name: organize_document_layers
title: Organize Document Layers
